title: Cargo Smoke Detection Regulator — Installation
abstract: Installation of the cargo smoke detection regulator in the aft hold ceiling void, with the tube connection sequence, the flow check and the smoke functional check that release the channel.

sections.purpose: This task gives the procedure to install the cargo smoke detection regulator in the aft hold ceiling void and to release the detection channel back to service.
sections.job_setup_note: Make sure the removal task is complete and that the sampling tubes have stayed capped. Get the flow check gauge and the smoke generator, and confirm with the flight compartment that a detection warning during the functional check is expected. The regulator must be at the configuration applicable to the sampling port standard fitted; a post modification regulator on an aircraft with open ports will give flow values outside the band and cannot be released.
sections.procedure: 1. Remove the optical face cover and do a visual check of the optical face for scratches and contamination. 2. Hold the regulator in position in the ceiling void and install the four mounting screws hand tight. 3. Torque the screws in a diagonal sequence to the value in the fits and clearances table. 4. Remove the capping plug from each sampling tube and connect the tubes to the regulator in the order marked on the tube labels. 5. CAUTION: DO NOT CROSS THE SAMPLING TUBES. A CROSSED PAIR GIVES A CORRECT FLOW CHECK AND AN INCORRECT COMPARTMENT INDICATION. 6. Remove the connector cap and connect the electrical connector. 7. Remove the do-not-close tag and close the circuit breaker. 8. Do the flow check at each port and confirm the value is between 24 and 36 litres per minute. 9. WARNING: TELL THE FLIGHT COMPARTMENT BEFORE YOU RELEASE SMOKE INTO THE COMPARTMENT. 10. Do the detection functional check with the smoke generator at each port and confirm the correct compartment is indicated. 11. Clear the detection warning and confirm the channel returns to normal. 12. Refit the ceiling lining panel.
sections.close_out: Close the aft cargo door and remove the safety barriers. Tell the flight compartment that the detection channel is serviceable. Record the installation, the regulator serial number, the flow values and the functional check result in the aircraft technical log.

safety_precautions: Tell the flight compartment before smoke is released into the compartment.
Do not close the circuit breaker until the tubes and the connector are secure.
